item.title: Alibaba Shares Jump 5% as Alipay Launches New Merchant Platform
item.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. shares rose the most in two weeks as the launch of a new ecommerce platform boosted optimism toward the company before its June quarter earnings this week.

item.title: India Weighs Sugar Import Duty Cut to Curb Record Local Prices
item.description: India, the world’s second-largest sugar producer, is considering cutting its import duty on the commodity to help curb domestic prices that recently climbed to a record.

item.title: Germany Is Set to Sell 30-Year Bonds at Highest Yield Since 2011
item.description: Germany’s borrowing costs are poised to hit a 15-year high in a major sale of long-dated bonds as investors demand greater compensation for lending to increasingly indebted governments still grappling with inflation.

item.title: Tanker Stops in Hormuz as Iran Raises Efforts to Control Strait
item.description: A fuel tanker trying to enter the Persian Gulf has made an erratic series of turns and come to a halt near Iran’s Qeshm Island, as the country steps up efforts to control the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: More German Companies Are Closing Down Due to Economic Headwinds
item.description: A greater number of German companies closed shop last year in another sign of how challenging conditions and an aging society are taking a toll on Europe’s biggest economy.

item.title: UK Food Inflation at Lowest Since October 2024 as Britons Hunt for Deals
item.description: Food price inflation in the UK slowed to the lowest level in nearly two years, as British shoppers searched for bargains to keep costs down.

item.title: Rising Yields Threaten to Puncture Asia’s AI-Driven Stock Rally
item.description: A rapid climb in Treasury yields is emerging as one of the biggest risks to Asia’s AI-driven stock rally, an uneasy link that highlights technology firms’ vulnerability to elevated borrowing costs.

item.title: US Stock-Index Futures Drop as Bond Yields and Oil Prices Rise
item.description: US stock-index futures fell as rising bond yields and a spike in oil prices unnerved investors.

item.title: Braskem’s Mexico Unit Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy in US
item.description: Mexico’s Braskem Idesa SAPI, a joint venture between Brazil’s Braskem SA and the conglomerate of Mexican tycoon Carlos Slim, has filed for bankruptcy protection as mounting financial strain and a worsening liquidity crunch weigh on the company.

item.title: Bridgewater China Withstands July Rout That Left Quants Reeling
item.description: Macro hedge funds in China including Bridgewater Associates LP’s local unit emerged from the July selloff bruised but not defeated, holding on to their annual gains after a wild stock market selloff that pushed other funds into the red.

item.title: UK Payrolls Fall, Vacancies Hit 5-Year Low in Weak Jobs Market
item.description: UK employers shed more workers in July and job vacancies hit a fresh five-year low as demand for staff remained tepid in the face of heightened uncertainty from events at home and abroad.

item.title: FTSE 100 Live: UK Payrolls Fall as Businesses Cite Cost Pressures
item.description: FTSE 100 Live: UK Payrolls Fall as Businesses Cite Cost Pressures【原文：FTSE 100 Live: UK Payrolls Fall as Businesses Cite Cost Pressures】

item.title: China Axing Microsoft Windows From State Agencies Ahead of Plan
item.description: China is pulling the plug on an older version of Microsoft Corp.’s Windows tailored for government agencies, taking another step toward rooting out the world’s most popular PC software in a broader effort to reduce its dependence on foreign technology.

item.title: NSE Said to Seek Up to $55 Billion Valuation in Record India IPO
item.description: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd., the operator of the world’s largest derivatives exchange by trading volume, is seeking a valuation of as much as 5.26 trillion rupees ($55 billion) in its planned initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Bond Rout Sends Long-Term Borrowing Costs to Highest in Decades
item.description: Longer-maturity bonds are at the epicenter of investor angst about everything from inflation to the debt-laden artificial-intelligence boom — and governments are paying the price.

item.title: Traders Short French Bonds as Fight Over Budget Set to Escalate
item.description: Investors are turning bearish on French government bonds, as politicians ready for a fight over the 2027 budget before next year’s presidential election.

item.title: Situational Awareness Sold Taiyo Yuden Shares to Citadel, Others
item.description: Situational Awareness sold shares in Japan’s Taiyo Yuden Co. to Citadel and other investors when it offloaded part of its stake this month, it said in a filing.

item.title: Why China's DeepSeek, Qwen and Moonshot Are a Worry for US AI Rivals
item.description: Chinese AI models are cheaper and more adaptable than the preeminent US platforms, and studies suggest they’re now almost as proficient. How did that happen?

item.title: Congo Ebola Outbreak: Financial Oversight Takes Priority as Distrust Grows
item.description: Ebola is reviving suspicions of profiteering in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where distrust over how response money is handled is undermining the community cooperation needed to contain the world’s fastest-growing outbreak.

item.title: Chinese Companies Slow FX Sales in July as Yuan Support Fades
item.description: Net sales of foreign exchange by Chinese companies fell to a eight-month low in July, suggesting a key source of support for the yuan is fading.

item.title: Japan Five-Year Bond Sale Draws Strongest Demand Since June 2025
item.description: Japan’s five-year government bond auction Tuesday saw the strongest demand since June 2025, as elevated yields underpinned buying.

item.title: Indian Rupee, Bond Bets Retreat as Dollar Swap Window Ends Early
item.description: Caught off-guard by India’s decision to close early a special window to draw foreign-currency deposits, traders are now paring bets on gains in the rupee and short-term bonds.

item.title: Xi’s No. 2 Urges More Support for Economy After Big Growth Slump
item.description: China’s economy showed across-the-board weakness in July and growth likely slipped further below the government’s annual target, sparking a call from Premier Li Qiang on officials to ramp up supportive measures.

item.title: Supply Crunch Grips Copper Market as Key Spread Flares Out
item.description: Copper was headed for another day of turbulent trading after a key indicator of short-term supply tightness on the London Metal Exchange spiked.

item.title: Indian IPOs Shine Bright Even as Nifty Loses Momentum
item.description: The primary market is picking up pace, with eight of the past 10 IPOs seeing strong investor demand.

item.title: Korea Jettisons Startup From High-Stakes Sovereign AI Contest
item.description: South Korea eliminated a team led by Motif Technologies Co. from its sovereign AI competition, narrowing the high-stakes contest to three remaining groups.

item.title: Yardeni Warns Bond Vigilantes Stirring as US Yields Near 5%
item.description: Yardeni Research warned that investors are showing growing signs of unease over rising government debt, though it said there’s no reason to push the panic button on the US bond market just yet.

item.title: Prabowo’s ‘Pragmatic’ Speech Comforts Weary Indonesia Investors
item.description: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto’s annual speech on Friday was a rare uneventful affair, and that’s exactly what investors wanted to hear.

item.title: Korea Denies Report on Discussing Chips as First US Investment
item.description: South Korea denied a local media report that the government is discussing a semiconductor project as the first investment under its $350 billion commitment to the US.

item.title: Australian Consumer Confidence Improves After RBA Rate Pause
item.description: Australian consumer confidence advanced this month in response to the Reserve Bank’s decision to extend a pause in interest-rate increases, though pessimism persisted over the broader economic outlook.
